CREATE FUNCTION harborview.gold.clinic_row_filter(
  clinic_id STRING)
RETURNS BOOLEAN
RETURN
  IS_ACCOUNT_GROUP_MEMBER('compliance_team')
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM harborview.gold.clinic_access_map m
    WHERE m.user_email = current_user()
      AND m.clinic_id = clinic_row_filter.clinic_id
  );
caption: Group membership first, then a clinic_access_map lookup -- never a hardcoded clinic list.

code:
CREATE FUNCTION harborview.gold.mask_patient_name(
  patient_name STRING)
RETURNS STRING
RETURN CASE
  WHEN IS_ACCOUNT_GROUP_MEMBER('compliance_team')
  THEN patient_name
  ELSE NULL
END;
caption: Same shape for patient_ssn -- compliance sees it, everyone else sees NULL.
